alternatives.labelRationale: This pathway gives greater weight to climate processes, signals, quantitative modelling, algorithms, Earth observation, machine learning and image-based spatial evidence.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: This route makes climate sensing and computational spatial analysis the organising priority. Relative to the closest programme it replaces biodiversity, probability, remediation and ecosystem study with linear algebra, algorithms, computer vision and nature-based engineering; the pair differs by four courses and 30 EC in each direction.

alternatives.concept: A subsurface-resource and energy-transition direction connecting soils, aquifers, geothermal energy, carbon storage and critical resources with modelling, signals, life-cycle analysis, remediation, renewable-system design and environmental justice.

alternatives.labelRationale: This pathway centres subsurface science, geodata, numerical and signal analysis, resource recovery, life-cycle impacts, renewable systems and environmental responsibility.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: This route makes subsurface resources and the energy transition the organising priority. Relative to the closest programme it replaces biodiversity, probability, water-management and ecosystem courses with linear algebra, linear systems, life-cycle analysis, nature-based engineering and environmental justice. Relative to the climate-data route it replaces water management, algorithms and computer vision with linear systems, life-cycle analysis, remediation and environmental justice. It differs from each earlier programme by at least four courses and 30 EC in each direction.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme covers integrated Earth systems, climate, soils, water, resources, geospatial evidence and research. Climate sensing/geospatial analysis and subsurface resources/energy responsibility form two further independently evidenced, coherent and mechanically feasible directions. All three pass the pairwise 30-EC distinctness floor, so production stops at the maximum. These are retained internal provisional concepts,not final academic approvals. Current third-year external source gate remains unresolved. Two internal course rationales are narrowed to actual calculus and generic statistical-learning content; selections,schedules andpartialalignment rows are unchanged.

notes.text: TU Delft prescribes mechanics, thermodynamics, chemistry, fields and waves, fluid dynamics, atmosphere and ocean dynamics, geological engineering, geodata, international fieldwork, engineering design and a 15-EC thesis.
